description: Annual and 10-year housing credits and equity from eligible basis, applicable fraction, credit type (4 or 9), the optional 130% basis boost and a credit price (default: the latest public median). Uses the statutory floor unless applicable_percentage is given. Same math as the lihtc.loans credit estimator.

applicable_fraction.description: Low-income share of the building, 0 to 1 (or a percent)

applicable_percentage.description: Override the rate, in percent (e.g. 3.53) when the floor does not apply

name: calculate_credits
title: LIHTC credit and equity estimate
